patient_persona.description: Puan Nurul Izzati binti Hamdan, 28, female, first-time mother and online seller in Shah Alam, speaking for her son Umar, 8 months. Tired, soft-spoken, Selangor Malay with English words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Priya Nair, Malaysian Indian woman in her 40s, paediatrician at a Shah Alam private hospital. Warm, reassuring; English and fluent Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, pipi Umar merah, kasar, dia gosok-gosok muka kat bantal. Lipatan siku pun sama. Dah dua bulan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let me see. Pipi kering, merah, ada sikit calar. Siku, belakang lutut pun. Ni eczema, atopic dermatitis. Dalam keluarga ada asthma, resdung, eczema?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Suami saya ada asthma masa kecil. Saya ada resdung.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ha, memang selalu ikut keluarga. Kulit dia macam dinding yang bocor, air keluar, kering, senang gatal. Jadi kita kena repair dengan moisturiser.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya ada guna minyak zaitun, dengan krim bayi yang wangi tu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Krim wangi tu stop dulu, boleh irritate. Guna emollient tanpa pewangi, macam emulsifying ointment atau cetaphil cream, sapu banyak, sekurang-kurangnya dua kali sehari.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Mandi macam mana? Saya mandikan dia dua kali sehari dengan sabun.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Sekali sehari cukup, air suam, lima sampai sepuluh minit. Guna soap-free wash. Lepas mandi, tepuk kering, terus sapu moisturiser dalam tiga minit.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yang merah kat pipi tu, perlu krim ubat?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya. Hydrocortisone 1% cream, sapu nipis dekat bahagian merah, dua kali sehari, lima sampai tujuh hari. Lepas tu stop, sambung moisturiser saja.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hydrocortisone tu steroid kan? Saya takut kulit dia nipis.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ni steroid paling lemah. Kalau guna ikut cara, sekejap-sekejap macam ni, selamat untuk bayi. Tak guna pun lagi bahaya, sebab gatal tu buat luka.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Susu dia, patut tukar ke? Kawan cakap mungkin allergy susu lembu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kebanyakan eczema bukan sebab susu. Jangan tukar sendiri. Kalau lepas treatment ni masih teruk, baru kita fikir pasal food allergy.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik doktor. Bila datang balik?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Dua minggu. Kalau kulit jadi bernanah, berkerak kuning, atau ada lenting berkumpul dan dia demam, datang cepat, itu jangkitan.

condition: Atopic dermatitis flare in a young adult

patient_persona.description: Yeoh Shu Ting, 24, female, final-year law student in Kepong, Kuala Lumpur; eczema since childhood, worse during exams. Articulate, frustrated, Malaysian Mandarin with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chew Li Ann, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, dermatologist at a KL private clinic. Clear, empathetic; Mandarin and English.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我的 eczema 最近很严重，脖子、手肘、眼皮都红红的，很痒，晚上睡不着。下个月我有 final exam。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我明白，考试 stress 常常会 trigger flare。你现在用什么药？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我只用 moisturiser。之前 GP 给我 steroid cream，我不敢用，网上说会 thin skin，还有 topical steroid withdrawal。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 很多人有这个担心。正确使用、短时间用，steroid 是安全又有效的。问题是乱用或者用太强的在脸上。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我要怎样用才正确？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 身体和手肘，用 betamethasone valerate 0.1%，一天一次，用一个 fingertip unit 擦两个手掌那么大的面积，用一到两个礼拜。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Fingertip unit 是什么？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 从 tube 挤出来，从手指尖到第一个关节那么长，就是一个 unit。擦薄薄一层就够。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那眼皮和脖子呢？也擦同一个吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 不要。眼皮和脖子皮肤很薄，我给你 tacrolimus 0.1% ointment，这个不是 steroid。刚开始擦会有一点热热的，几天就会习惯。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好。痒的时候可以吃什么吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 晚上可以吃 cetirizine 10mg，帮助睡觉。不过 eczema 的痒，antihistamine 效果有限，主要还是靠 cream。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Flare 好了以后，我就停？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 好了以后，常常复发的地方，一个礼拜擦两天 tacrolimus 做 maintenance。这个叫 proactive therapy，可以减少 flare。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 如果考试的时候又爆发怎么办？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 马上开始擦，不要等到很严重。Moisturiser 每天至少两次，不能停。一个月后回来 follow-up。

condition: Infected atopic eczema in a child

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Revathi a/p Ramasamy, 34, female, bank teller in Ipoh, speaking for her son Kishen, 4, who has eczema. Worried, quick, Malaysian Indian English with Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lim Chee Keong, Malaysian Chinese man in his 50s, GP at an Ipoh clinic. Gentle, unhurried; English with some Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, Kishen's eczema suddenly teruk. Behind the knees got yellow crust, wet, smells a bit. He keeps scratching.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let me look. Yes, honey-coloured crusts, weeping. This eczema is infected with bacteria, usually Staph. Any fever?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Little bit last night, 37.8. Today no. He's still playing, makan pun OK.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Any blisters that look punched out, grouped together? Or very painful?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, just the crust and wet. Pain, he says a bit sakit when I apply cream.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: OK, that sounds like bacterial, not the herpes type. He needs an oral antibiotic because it's quite widespread. Cephalexin syrup, 250mg four times a day, seven days.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Four times, OK. Should I stop his steroid cream now since dah infected?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: No, continue. The steroid treats the eczema, the antibiotic treats the infection. Stopping the cream will make it worse.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh. I stopped already since hari Ahad, I thought it's the cream causing.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's why it flared more. Restart the mometasone once a day on the eczema patches. Moisturiser too, but use a new tub.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: New tub? Kenapa?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: When fingers go in and out of the old tub, bacteria can grow inside. Throw that one. Use a clean spoon to scoop from the new one.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Wah, didn't think of that. Ada lagi?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cut his nails short. Some doctors suggest a dilute bleach bath twice a week, but let's first see how he responds.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK doctor. Bila should I come back?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: In three days. Sooner if he gets high fever, painful clustered blisters, or looks lemah. That could be eczema herpeticum, which is an emergency.

condition: Severe atopic eczema in a teenager, follow-up

patient_persona.description: Muhammad Danish bin Rizal, 15, male, secondary school student in Kuching, Sarawak; severe eczema since childhood, teased at school. Quiet, self-conscious, Sarawak Malay mixed with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lucy Wong, Sarawakian Chinese woman in her 40s, consultant dermatologist at Sarawak General Hospital. Encouraging, speaks to teens directly; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Danish, last time kita mula wet wrap dan phototherapy. Dah enam minggu. Macam mana rasa?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Better sikit, doktor. Gatal malam dah kurang. Tapi tangan still merah, especially lepas main bola.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let me see. Badan dan kaki banyak improve. SCORAD dulu 62, sekarang 38. Tangan dan leher masih aktif.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Phototherapy tu kena datang tiga kali seminggu, susah. Ayah kena ambil cuti.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: I faham. Ada option lain. Kita boleh cuba ubat makan, ciclosporin, untuk kawal cepat. Tapi kena check darah dan blood pressure selalu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat makan tu kuat ke? Kawan saya kata ubat steroid buat gemuk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ciclosporin bukan steroid. Tak buat gemuk. Tapi dia boleh kena buah pinggang, sebab tu kena monitor. Biasanya guna beberapa bulan je.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada injection yang orang sebut dupilumab tu? Saya tengok kat TikTok.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Haha, you did your research. Dupilumab memang berkesan, tapi mahal, dan di hospital kerajaan belum senang dapat. Kita boleh apply, tapi ambil masa.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK. Saya try ciclosporin dulu lah, kalau boleh tak payah datang selalu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good. Kita check darah hari ni, creatinine, liver, dan BP. Kalau OK, mula 100mg dua kali sehari. Dua minggu lagi datang check semula.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Cream semua still kena sapu?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya. Moisturiser tetap, setiap hari. Steroid cream bila flare. Ubat makan ni tambahan, bukan ganti.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, kawan-kawan kat sekolah suka ejek, kata berjangkit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Eczema tak berjangkit, langsung. Kalau you nak, saya tulis surat untuk cikgu kelas, terangkan. Dan kalau rasa sedih sangat, cakap dengan saya, OK?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, doktor. Terima kasih.

condition: Hand eczema in a kitchen worker

patient_persona.description: Madam Chua Bee Lian, 45, female, dishwasher and cook at a family kopitiam in Batu Pahat, Johor. Rough-voiced, busy, Johor Mandarin with Hokkien words and a little Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Anuar bin Ismail, Malay man in his 50s, GP at a Batu Pahat clinic for many years. Practical, speaks decent Mandarin with English and Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我的手很干、裂开，手指这边会流血，洗碗的时候很痛。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我看看。手掌和手指都很干，有 crack，还有小小的水泡。多久了？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 三四个月了。在 kopitiam 洗碗，一天洗几百个，用那个 sabun 很强的。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个是 hand eczema，手部湿疹。一直碰水和 detergent，皮肤的保护层坏掉了。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我有戴手套，可是手套里面都是汗。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以里面戴一双 cotton glove，外面才戴 rubber glove，就不会太湿。手套破了要马上换。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那药呢？我有买 Betnovate 擦，好一点点。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 手掌皮比较厚，需要强一点的 steroid。我开 mometasone ointment，晚上擦，一天一次，两个礼拜。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ointment 很油，我怎样工作？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 晚上睡觉前擦，然后戴 cotton glove 睡。白天就用 moisturiser，每次洗手以后都要擦。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 每次洗手都擦？一天几十次，哪有时间。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我明白。至少休息的时候、下班的时候擦。在 sink 旁边放一罐，方便一点。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 裂开的那些，会不会 infection？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 现在没有 infection 的样子。如果变黄、流脓、红肿，就要回来。两个礼拜后再 review。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好。可以给我 MC 吗？休息几天手可能会好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我给你两天 MC。不过长远来说，最重要是保护手，不然一回去工作又会复发。

patient_persona.description: Mr. Loke Kin Wah, 50, male, hardware shop owner in Ipoh; smokes and drinks beer most nights. Loud, sceptical, Cantonese-accented Malaysian Mandarin with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chin Yen Ping, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 40s, dermatologist at an Ipoh private hospital. Frank, patient; Mandarin and English.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我手肘、膝盖有很厚的白色皮，一直掉，好像头皮屑。GP 说是 fungus，擦了两个月都没好。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我看看。手肘、膝盖、腰后面，还有头皮 hairline 这里。红色的 plaque，上面有银白色的 scale。这个是 psoriasis，银屑病。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 银屑病？会传染吗？我的店员都不敢靠近我。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 完全不会传染。这是免疫系统的问题，皮肤细胞长得太快，一层一层堆起来。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那可以根治吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Psoriasis 是 chronic 的，会好会坏，不能根治，但是可以控制得很好。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要吃什么药？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的面积大概百分之五，先用 cream。Calcipotriol 加 betamethasone 的 gel，一天一次，擦在 plaque 上，四个礼拜。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 头皮也可以擦吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以，这个 gel 头皮也能用。另外用 coal tar shampoo，一个礼拜洗两三次，留五分钟再冲。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有没有什么东西不能吃？海鲜、鸡蛋这些？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 食物没有直接关系。可是抽烟和喝酒会让 psoriasis 更严重，也影响心脏。你一天抽多少？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一包左右。晚上跟朋友喝三四罐啤酒。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Psoriasis 的人比较容易有 high blood pressure、diabetes、cholesterol。今天我们也验血，check 一下。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好吧，验就验。烟我试试看减少。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 好。一个月后 follow-up。如果关节开始痛、肿，早上很硬，要马上告诉我，那可能是 psoriatic arthritis。

patient_persona.description: Puan Rozita binti Hashim, 38, female, secondary school teacher in Alor Setar, Kedah; psoriasis for 12 years, on methotrexate for six months, hoping for a third child. Cheerful, steady, Kedah Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Zulkifli bin Hamid, Malay man in his 40s, dermatologist at Hospital Sultanah Bahiyah, Alor Setar. Friendly, thorough; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan Rozita, kulit nampak cantik hari ni. PASI dulu 18, sekarang 4. Methotrexate memang menjadi.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Alhamdulillah, doktor. Dah lama saya tak pakai baju lengan pendek. Sekarang dah berani.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Result darah hari ni pun saya dah tengok. Full blood count normal. Liver enzyme ALT 34, normal. Creatinine pun OK.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Lega. Saya ambil 15mg seminggu sekali, hari Ahad, macam doktor suruh. Folic acid pun ambil.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Folic acid 5mg tu, hari apa puan ambil?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hari Rabu, sekali seminggu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus, betul. Ada ulser mulut, loya, atau batuk lama?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Loya sikit hari Isnin, lepas makan ubat. Tapi tahan lagi. Doktor, sebenarnya saya dan suami nak cuba anak ketiga.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Terima kasih bagitahu. Ni penting. Methotrexate boleh sebabkan kecacatan bayi dan keguguran. Kena stop sekurang-kurangnya tiga bulan sebelum cuba mengandung.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tiga bulan? Nanti psoriasis saya datang balik teruk?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Mungkin naik sikit. Tapi ada rawatan lebih selamat masa mengandung, macam phototherapy narrowband UVB, dan krim steroid.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Phototherapy tu kena datang hospital?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, dua tiga kali seminggu. Dan kalau teruk sangat, ada ubat lain yang boleh guna dalam pregnancy, kita bincang dengan pakar O&G.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK. Jadi mulai minggu ni saya stop methotrexate?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, stop mulai Ahad ni. Folic acid teruskan, tukar ke setiap hari, 5mg. Sementara tu guna contraception tiga bulan dulu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Faham, doktor. Nanti saya bincang dengan suami.

patient_persona.description: Mr. Arvind a/l Sivalingam, 42, male, IT project manager in Petaling Jaya; scalp and nail psoriasis for years. Precise, a bit anxious, Malaysian Indian English with a few Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Nabilah binti Zainal, Malay woman in her 30s, dermatologist at a PJ private hospital. Crisp, friendly; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, my scalp is quite controlled with the shampoo. But these few months my fingers are swollen and painful, especially morning.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Show me your hands. The middle finger is swollen like a sausage, and the nails got pits and are lifting. How long is the morning stiffness?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: About one hour. After a hot shower then can move properly. Sometimes my heel also sakit when I step down.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Heel pain, sausage finger, nail changes. With your psoriasis, I'm quite concerned this is psoriatic arthritis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Arthritis? I'm only 42. I thought that's penyakit orang tua.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Psoriatic arthritis often starts between 30 and 50. It's inflammation, not wear and tear. If untreated, the joints can get damaged permanently.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: So macam mana now? I've been taking Arcoxia from the pharmacy sometimes.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Etoricoxib helps pain, but doesn't stop the damage. I'll order X-rays of the hands and feet, blood tests for ESR, CRP, rheumatoid factor, and refer you to rheumatology.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: What treatment usually?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Often methotrexate first. If not enough, biologics like adalimumab or secukinumab, which treat both skin and joints.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Biologics, those injections? Mahal, right?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: They can be. Some insurance covers it, and adalimumab biosimilars are cheaper now. Let the rheumatologist assess first, then we plan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK. My insurance got outpatient specialist coverage, nanti I check.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Meanwhile, keep the etoricoxib 90mg once a day after food for two weeks max. And your BP, last reading was 142 over 90, please monitor.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Noted. My father got high BP also. OK, doctor, I'll book the X-ray downstairs.

condition: Guttate psoriasis after a sore throat

patient_persona.description: Cheryl Gontusan, 29, female, Kadazan kindergarten teacher in Penampang, Sabah. Cheerful, expressive, Sabahan English with Malay and 'bah'.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Azman bin Latip, Sabahan Malay man in his 40s, GP at a Penampang clinic. Easy-going, clear; English and Sabahan Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, suddenly I got so many small red spots on my body and legs. Macam titik hujan. Since last week.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any illness before this? Sakit tekak, fever?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes! About three weeks ago I had very bad sore throat. The klinik gave me antibiotic, then OK already.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let me see. Small, drop-shaped, scaly spots, all over the trunk and thighs. This looks like guttate psoriasis. It's often triggered by a strep throat infection.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Psoriasis? My uncle got psoriasis, very tebal on his legs. Is it the same?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Same family of disease, different pattern. Guttate type in young people often clears in a few months. Some later develop plaque type, like your uncle.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Aiyo. Can it go away completely bah?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Many do, especially after the first episode. We'll help it along. Sunlight actually helps, so short exposure, 15 minutes a day, don't get burnt.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Easy, Sabah got plenty of sun. Ada cream?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Because the spots are many, cream everywhere is leceh. I'll give a moderate steroid cream for the itchy ones, and moisturiser for the rest.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Is my throat still infected? I'm teaching budak kecil, don't want to pass them anything.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Your throat looks clear now. I'll do a throat swab to be sure. If positive, another course of antibiotic.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: And if it tak hilang?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If not better in six to eight weeks, I refer you to dermatology at Hospital Queen Elizabeth. They can do phototherapy, which works very well for this type.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK, doctor. Thank you, I was so scared it's penyakit serius.

condition: Erythrodermic psoriasis after stopping unlabelled traditional medicine

patient_persona.description: Mr. Siow Kim Chuan, 70, male, retired contractor in Kepong, Kuala Lumpur; took an unlabelled herbal powder from a traditional seller for his psoriasis. Weak, shivering, slow Malaysian Mandarin.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lai Wen Hui, Malaysian Chinese woman in her 30s, dermatology registrar on the ward round at Hospital Kuala Lumpur. Firm but kind; Mandarin with English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Uncle，早安。今天还有发冷吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 还是冷，医生，全身皮都红红的，一直掉皮，床上都是。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的皮肤百分之九十都红了，这个叫 erythrodermic psoriasis。皮肤没办法保暖，也会流失很多水分和 protein。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 以前我吃那个药粉，皮肤很好。停了一个月，就变成这样。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 那个药粉我们送去 lab 检验，里面有 dexamethasone，是 steroid。突然停，psoriasis 就反弹，变更严重。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那个人说是纯草药，没有西药。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 很多没有 label 的产品都偷偷加 steroid。长期吃会伤骨头、血糖高、伤 adrenal gland。我们会通知 KKM pharmacy enforcement。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 唉，我真的不知道。那现在怎样？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我们给你很小剂量的 hydrocortisone，因为你的身体可能自己不够 steroid，突然停会有危险。然后慢慢减。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 皮肤要擦什么？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 护士一天几次帮你擦 emollient，还有 wet wrap。我们也开始 ciclosporin，控制 psoriasis，今天是第二天。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我的 blood test 怎样？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Albumin 有一点低，28。Kidney OK。血糖 11，有一点高，所以我们每天验几次 sugar。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要住多久？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 大概一到两个礼拜，要看皮肤退红多少，体温稳不稳定。家里还有那个药粉吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 还有两包。我叫我儿子丢掉。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 先不要丢，拿来给我们，可以帮助调查。以后吃任何药，先问医生或者 pharmacist，OK？
